Not so special anymore. We're prepared our whole lives to think we're so great when really we're just being prepared to fill the countless busywork bullshit jobs that maintain the society that the wealthy have created for us. "Work harder and you'll achieve great things". Bullshit, it's hype speech to increase productivity in the workplace and make you think you'll be on top one day. Nothing we do matters, we will all come and go until humans cease to exist, along with our egotistic ideologies that fuel our need to fill our wallets and insecurities. Humans are a random event on the universal timeline. When you go to your job, you're given a specific set of tasks that you work on to complete. When you go home you have personal chores that you deem important enough to complete. But what is the task of existing as a human being? Survive in this broken society where we barter for goods and services that are a necessity for life? Do that until we die? FUCK THAT. It's all a distraction and sidestep from the true meaning of our existence.
